votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 07 of 2023, recognizing March 31, 2023, as International Transgender Day of Visibility in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: Adopts a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing March 31, 2023 as International Transgender Day of Visibility in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the item (Funding Allocations for One-year Action Plan for Community Development Block Grant & Other Federal Grants for FY 2023-24) to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY 2023-24 HUD grants funding allocations (CDBG, HOME, ESG, HOPWA) and defers action to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing to a future date for the ordinance rezoning and master plan amendment at 865 South 500 East.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on the proposed rezone of 865 S 500 E from RMF-30 to CN and associated Central Community Master Plan amendment to a future date.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the item (Ordinance: Electric Vehicle Readiness Off-Street Parking Stalls Amendment) to a future date for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance requiring EV-ready electrical capacity on 20% of off-street parking stalls in new multi-family construction and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 13 of 2023, Budget Amendment No. 5 for FY 2022-2023 including the employment staffing document only for item I-4: 'Lockhart Alley' Reconstructing Three Sections ($208,373 from General Fund Balance to CIP Fund).
votes.description: Approves a partial budget amendment funding reconstruction of three sections of Lockhart Alley in the Ballpark neighborhood.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 13 of 2023, Budget Amendment No. 5 for FY 2022-2023 including the employment staffing document only for item A-10: Real Property Purchase ($825,000 from General Fund Balance to the CIP Fund).
votes.description: Approves a partial budget amendment for a real property purchase, voted on separately due to Council Member Mano's recusal.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 13 of 2023, Budget Amendment No. 5 of FY 2022-2023 including items A-1 through A-9, A-11, D-1, D-3 through D-7, Council Consent Agenda No. 5 (G-1, G-2), Section G Council Consent Agenda No. 6 (G-1), I-1, I-2, and I-3.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts the remaining items of Budget Amendment No. 5 for FY 2022-23, covering a broad range of city expenditures including City Hall earthquake repairs, public safety radio upgrades, police retention bonuses, and other items.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Text Amendment to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed ADU zoning code amendments and defers final action to a future meeting, allowing further deliberation on issues such as owner occupancy requirements.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 8 of 2023, amendment to the 2021-2022 HUD Annual Action Plan to include the HOME-ARPA funding and allocation plan.
votes.description: Authorizes $3.5 million in HOME-ARPA grant funding for housing opportunities for individuals experiencing or at risk of homelessness and domestic violence survivors, amending the 2021-2022 HUD Annual Action Plan.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 14 of 2023, Amending the Zoning Text Pertaining to the use of Landscape Materials.
votes.description: Amends the City's zoning code to limit lawn grass and make related landscape changes, enabling the City to qualify for rebate programs that incentivize water-wise landscaping.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 15 of 2023, Glendale Regional Park Plan as part of Salt Lake City's general plan.
votes.description: Adopts the Glendale Regional Park Plan as part of the City's general plan under the Westside Master Plan, guiding development of the 17-acre former Raging Waters site.

votes.motion: Deny the annexation petition without prejudice and initiate a legislative action requesting the City Administration start a City-led process to annex properties in unincorporated Salt Lake County generally located north of 2100 North and west of I-215.
votes.description: Denies the private annexation petition at approximately 2200 West between 2800 North and 3300 North without prejudice, and initiates a City-led annexation process for the broader area to give the City control over development and environmental planning.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (Grant Holding Account Items Batch No. 7 for FY 2022-23, and board appointments for Jason Wessel, Teresa Gregori, Miranda Cask, and Dave John).
votes.description: Approves grant holding account items and four board appointments: Jason Wessel to the Racial Equity in Policing Commission, Teresa Gregori and Miranda Cask to the CDCIP Advisory Board, and Dave John to the PNUT Advisory Board.
